title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

sanjay: onboarding Orpheus-v1 (q4 toggle) — quick smoke found a weird locale regression. zh->ar samples with embedded Arabic numerals (e.g., 2026年 -> ٢٠٢٦) are coming out with the numerals mirrored and trailing punctuation attached to the wrong side. BLEU on locale testset dropped 4.1 -> 2.0. anyone else seeing numeral/orientation flips?
liyue: seen something like this with hybrid scripts + RTL fallbacks. can you paste a repro sample?
oliver: can you also share which tokenization profile was used? we have a zh+ar merged vocab for Orpheus-v1 and a fallback bidi-normalizer that might be clobbered by q4 kernel rounding.
sanjay: repro snippet below. Run eval with our locale harness: `./eng-ml/evals/run_locale_eval --model orpheus-v1 --quant q4 --pairs zh-ar --subset mixed-numerals`
sanjay: example src: "2026年有三家医院位于开罗。" reference: "في عام ٢٠٢٦، توجد ثلاث مستشفيات في القاهرة." Orpheus-q4 output: "في عام ٦٠٢٢، توجد ثلاث مستشفيات في القاهرة." (note digits reversed and comma moved)
maria: whoa digit reversal suggests token-level mirror or bidi state lost during detokenize. do we preserve BIDI markers (RLM/LRM) through quant kernels?
kai: quick check: our detok pipeline uses soft_bidi_fix which expects 32-bit float logit ordering for some byte-level ops. q4 packer reorders groups for perf — might break sign-aware ops.
oliver: can we repro by running greedy decode with verbose tokens? `python -m orpheus.decode --model orpheus-v1-q4 --verbose-token` and paste tokens around the numerals.
ml-ci-bot: build 2026.03.21-orpheus-q4 deployed to staging; smoke tests: locale-mixed-numerals failed (2/5) — logs uploaded to https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7443219876/logs
liyue: I'll pull the token logs. if it's a KV cache addressing bug, we'd see token positions flip. if it's postproc, tokens correct but detok produces mirrored digits.
maria: quick hack: try enabling `preserve_unicode_direction=true` in detok config and rerun on staging — if that fixes, it's detok. if not, probably kernel-level reordering.
sanjay: reran with preserve_unicode_direction=true — small gain but still wrong digits (BLEU 2.6). attaching token stream next.
liyue: token stream shows tokens for digits are correct codepoints but their order is reversed in final string. detok receives ["٢٠٢٦"] tokens but reconstructs as "٦٠٢٢". looks like a string-level reverse happening.
kai: aha — we added an optimization to reverse short numeric spans for LTR preference earlier this quarter, thinking it was safe. that pass runs in the detok C-extension which we compiled with q4-compatible flags. maybe the q4 packer's memcpy ordering changed the iteration index.
oliver: can we toggle that numeric-span-reversal pass off and retest quickly in staging?
ml-ci-bot: test job queued: disable-opt numeric-span-reversal -> staging smoke.
sanjay: queued. thanks. if that's it we can roll a targeted detok patch rather than rolling back q4. need owners for patch.
maria: I'll take detok patch. will add a unit test with mixed Han+Arabic numerals and punctuation.
kai: I'll also add a CI gate to run mixed-orient locale smoke for quant builds. short-term mitigation: fallback to fp16 detok for q4 builds.
oliver: great. keep thread updated with CI results. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
